comment: Data Corrupter-inspired PLL synth-fuzz approximation. Tracks monophonic input and drives a square master, divided subharmonic, and FM-modulated harmony. The pedal build uses the Unison root mode; the independent Square voice and Oscillator root mode are not modeled.
gid_comment: 0x08 = Delay category -> SONAME prefix ZDL_DLY_. Grouped under DLY (fewest stock effects = easy to find).
fxid_comment: 0x01C6. Reverted from 477 to the last known-working id + safe default. (The 477 bump collided with stock effect fxids and broke on hardware; the audible-on-load Mix hack is obsolete now the editor materialises patches via a full-patch send.)

params.name: Master
params.comment: Tracked master oscillator pitch: unison, one octave down, or two octaves down.

params.name: Sub
params.comment: Level of the divided square subharmonic, one octave below the Master.

params.name: Harm
params.comment: Selects unison, fifth, octave, fourth, sub-octave, or 12th harmony.

params.name: Depth
params.comment: Frequency-modulator pitch depth, up to approximately three semitones.

audio_nop_comment: Set true for a UI-only smoke build before trusting the DSP.
